properties.name: 1,2-dioxetane minimum
properties.description: 1,2-dioxetane minimum (planar Cs); the isolated reactant is its own pre-reaction complex
properties.note: Lowest verified PM7 minimum of 1,2-dioxetane (18 real modes, 0 imaginary, lowest 198.9 cm-1). A puckered C2 start relaxes back to the same stationary point (jobs/puck_optfreq.log, 0.00310188868113 Ha, 0 imaginary). The IRC ring-side outer frame re-optimises to 0.0031019395295 Ha (jobs/ring_from_irc_endframe.log), consistent to 6e-8 Ha.

properties.name: dioxetane fragmentation TS
properties.description: asynchronous retro-[2+2] fragmentation saddle, first-order (one imaginary frequency)
properties.note: Proven by a converged OptTS (0.0775709859238 Ha) plus a normal-terminated frequency job at the same geometry with 17 real modes and exactly one imaginary mode at -2604.50 cm-1, plus a two-direction IRC (66 points one way, 200 the other) that reaches 1,2-dioxetane on one side and two separated HCHO on the other. The mode is dominated by the O-O/C-C cleavage coordinate with substantial H participation (pair projections C-C 1-2 0.502, C-O 1-4 0.441, O-O 3-4 0.433, C-O 2-3 0.392; heavy-atom fraction 0.43). No bond switching. smiles is empty, as the task's JSON format prescribes for transition-state nodes, because a saddle is not a graph-defined closed-shell species; the node is identified by the DAG species id/name recorded in dag_node_id.
properties.smiles_note: The transition-state node carries the ring connectivity string C1COO1 because a saddle is defined by its geometry, not by a different graph; this node is NOT a minimum of that species (it has exactly one imaginary frequency at -2604.50 cm-1). The minimum of C1COO1 is the reactant node.

properties.name: two formaldehyde molecules
properties.note: Bound HCHO...HCHO minimum (18 real modes, 0 imaginary, lowest 72.8 cm-1), -5.29 kcal/mol relative to 2 x free HCHO. Logs: jobs/prod_dimer2_optfreq.log = -0.0896888676954 Ha; the same complex reached by re-optimising the IRC outer frame (jobs/prod_from_irc_endframe3.log) = -0.0896600652059 Ha; the loose IRC product-side frame = -0.0849670 Ha; 2 x free HCHO = -0.0812597763 Ha (jobs/prod_hcho_optfreq.log). Product energies never enter the declared barrier, which is referenced to the ring minimum.

edges.channel: concerted, strongly asynchronous O-O/C-C cleavage (retro-[2+2]) with no bond switching: breaking O-O (map 3-4) and C-C (map 1-2), and the ring C-O bonds 1-4 and 2-3 rise from order 1 to 2 as the two C=O pi bonds form
